questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is coming ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you to drive carefully. The road may become wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must always come to a complete stop at a stop sign. Only go forward when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires a complete stop. You must let vehicles and pedestrians in or entering the intersection pass first. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign alerts you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Motorcyclists can use hand signals instead of turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing downward, it signals that the rider plans to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is one-way and you cannot enter from your current direction.

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has multiple curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers of work zones ahead. This sign means the highway is being repaired or maintained. Slow down and drive carefully through the work area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that traffic will merge onto your road from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer may cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch for animals, and be ready to stop.

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must stay to the right of a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead.

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. You should slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black and prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign tells you a lane is ending and you should be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering your roadway. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in.

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead and you should watch for trains.
